title: Councils
description: Panels of AI members that respond to a prompt from fixed roles — then a synthesizer distils them in any format: brainstorm, debate, analyse, and more.

empty.title: No councils yet
empty.description: Create one, add members with distinct roles, and put a prompt to them.

bulk.deleteTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {# council} other {# councils}}?

create.title: New council
create.name: Name
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What this council weighs in on

custom.title: Custom synthesis prompt
custom.blurb: This prompt is used as the synthesis task whenever a run’s format is Custom.

detail.noRun: Submit a prompt below and each member will respond from its role in its own terminal. The responses are then handed to the synthesizer and distilled in your chosen format.
detail.liveHint: A run is in progress — wait for the synthesis.
detail.noMembersHint: Add at least 1 member in the panel to start.

thread.title: Thread
thread.empty: No runs yet — submit the first prompt below.

members.title: Members
members.synthBlurb: Distils the pooled responses. The format is pre-selected for new runs and can be switched per run — and re-run over the same responses.
members.empty: Add at least 1 member — each responds to the prompt from its own role.
members.rolePlaceholder: Role to respond from — e.g. “Argue the contrary view.”

run.skipTitle: Stop waiting on this member — the synthesis proceeds without it
run.waiting: Waiting on {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}…
run.reSynthesizeBlurb: Re-runs only the synthesis over the captured responses — switch formats freely; members don’t re-run.

brainstorm.label: Brainstorm
brainstorm.description: Generate ideas, then cluster and curate the strongest.

debate.label: Debate
debate.description: Weigh anonymized positions into a single verdict.

analyse.label: Analyse
analyse.description: Neutral analysis of themes, agreements, and tensions.

critique.label: Critique
critique.description: Impartially stress-test each position — strengths and risks.

motivate.label: Motivate
motivate.description: Build the strongest optimistic case and a path forward.

demotivate.label: Demotivate
demotivate.description: A skeptical pre-mortem — surface every reason it fails.
